description: This file defines the SpgrContainer class, which manages a collection of shape group containers and shape containers within a graphical structure. It provides methods to set and get the parent container, add child containers, retrieve children, and recursively collect all shape containers contained within.

classes.name: SpgrContainer
classes.description: Represents a shape group container that can contain child containers or shape containers, supporting hierarchical structure and recursive retrieval of shape containers.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent shape group container, accepting a nullable instance of SpgrContainer.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent shape group container if set, or null.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child shape container or shape group container to the collection and sets its parent to this container.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves the array of child shape containers or shape group containers.

methods.name: getAllSpContainers
methods.description: Recursively collects all shape containers (not shape group containers) contained within this container and its descendants.
